function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT pl.period,
       SUM(pl.amount_cad)/SUM(pl.qty) AS avg_purchase_cost_per_unit_cad,
       SUM(CASE WHEN v.vendor_name = 'VEND-SNC' AND pl.sku IN ('NUT-ALM','NUT-CAS','NUT-PEC') THEN pl.amount_cad END) /
       NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN v.vendor_name = 'VEND-SNC' AND pl.sku IN ('NUT-ALM','NUT-CAS','NUT-PEC') THEN pl.qty END),0) AS vendor_sku_avg_cost
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor v ON pl.vendor_id = v.vendor_id
WHERE pl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY pl.period
ORDER BY pl.period","purpose":"Average purchase cost per unit overall and for specific vendor/SKUs"}
